# IAssetsForwarderEvents
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/utils/AssetsForwarder/IAssetsForwarderEvents.sol)

**Title:**
IAssetsForwarderEvents

Interface for the AssetsForwarder events


## Events
### AssetForwarded
Emitted when assets are forwarded from the sender to a target address


```solidity
event AssetForwarded(address indexed sender, address indexed target, address indexed asset, uint256 amount);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`sender`|`address`|The address that initiated the forward and provided the assets|
|`target`|`address`|The address that received the assets|
|`asset`|`address`|The address of the asset transferred|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets transferred|

### AssetSent
Emitted when existing assets in the contract are sent to a target address


```solidity
event AssetSent(address indexed target, address indexed asset, uint256 amount);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`target`|`address`|The address that received the assets|
|`asset`|`address`|The address of the asset transferred|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets transferred|

### AssetSwept
Emitted when existing assets in the contract are swept to the keeper


```solidity
event AssetSwept(address indexed keeper, address indexed asset, uint256 amount);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`keeper`|`address`|The address of the keeper that received the assets|
|`asset`|`address`|The address of the asset transferred|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets transferred|
